svg.title: Holy Bible RHIYME Version — exact RHIYME Genesis text

text.textPath: 1:1 Before anything had a name, God made tha heavenz N tha earth. Whole creation started wit him. • 1:2 Earth had no shape, nothing filled tha space. Darkness over tha deep, but God’s Spirit was movin over tha waterz. • 1:3 God said, “Let there b light.” He spoke it; light showed up. • 1:4 God peeped tha light was good N separated it from tha darkness. Each had its place. • 1:5 He named tha light Day N tha darkness Night. Evening, then morning—day 1. • 1:6 God said, “Put an expanse between tha waterz. Give tha waterz a dividing line.” • 1:7 He made tha expanse, separating tha waterz below from tha waterz above. Exactly how he called it. • 1:8 God named tha expanse Heaven. Evening, then morning—day 2. • 1:9 God said, “Waterz under heaven, gather in 1 place. Let dry ground show itself.” N it happened. • 1:10 Dry ground got tha name Earth; tha gathered waterz, Seaz. God peeped it was good. • 1:11 God said, “Earth, bring up grass, seed-bearing plantz, N fruit treez wit seed inside their fruit. Each growin according 2 its kind.” N it happened. • 1:12 Ground brought out grass, plantz carrying seed, N treez carrying fruit wit seed inside—each according 2 its kind. God peeped it was good. • 1:13 Evening, then morning—day 3. • 1:14 God said, “Let lightz fill heaven’s expanse, separating day from night. Let ’em mark signs, seasons, dayz, N yearz.” • 1:15 “Let ’em shine above N put light on tha earth.” N it happened. • 1:16 God made 2 gr8 lightz: tha greater 2 rule tha day, tha lesser 2 rule tha night. Tha starz were his work too. • 1:17 He set ’em in heaven’s expanse 2 light tha earth, • 1:18 2 govern day N night N separate light from darkness. God peeped it was good. • 1:19 Evening, then morning—day 4. • 1:20 God said, “Let tha waterz swarm wit living creaturez. Let birdz fly over tha earth across heaven’s open expanse.” • 1:21 God created tha gr8 sea creaturez N every living thing movin through tha waterz, each according 2 its kind. Every winged bird too. He peeped it was good. • 1:22 God blessed ’em: “B fruitful, multiply, fill tha seaz. Birdz, multiply across tha earth.” • 1:23 Evening, then morning—day 5. • 1:24 God said, “Earth, bring out living creaturez: livestock, crawlin thingz, wild animalz—each according 2 its kind.” N it happened. • 1:25 God made wild animalz, livestock, N everything crawlin on tha ground according 2 their kindz. He peeped it was good. • 1:26 God said, “Let us make humankind in our image, after our likeness. Let ’em rule over tha fish, birdz, livestock, all tha earth, N everything crawlin across it.” • 1:27 God created humankind in his own image. His image stamped on humanity—male N female, he created ’em. • 1:28 God blessed ’em: “B fruitful. Multiply. Fill tha earth N bring it under ur care N authority. Rule over tha fish, birdz, N every living thing movin here.” • 1:29 God said, “I’m givin y’all every seed-bearing plant on earth N every tree wit seed-bearing fruit. Dat’s ur food.” • 1:30 “Every wild animal, bird, N crawlin creature wit tha breath of life gets green plantz 4 food.” N dat’s how it was. • 1:31 God looked over everything he’d made. All of it—very good. Evening, then morning—day 6.
